en.name: GST Registration & Returns
en.description: Goods and Services Tax registration, return filing, and compliance for businesses via the GST portal.
en.eligibility: Businesses with aggregate turnover above threshold (Rs. 20 lakh/10 lakh/40 lakh by category) or mandated (inter-state, e-commerce, casual).
en.benefits: Legal tax identity, input tax credit, interstate trade, compliance certificates.
application_steps: Apply Part-A (Form GST REG-01) on gst.gov.in.
Get ARN; complete Part-B with documents.
faqs: What is the GST turnover threshold?
How do I register for GST?
